dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: I refer to Chioriya Boutique's Chiori, a designer from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: Her tastes... aren't bad, but we've got differences in ideas. She's also a rather picky character — even her works do not satisfy her.

dialogues.speaker: Mequignon
dialogues.text: The last time I spoke to her of a design flaw in her work, not only did she not get angry, but she even picked at her own work more vehemently than I. I didn't dare put a word in lengthwise...
